name: Satvik Vishwanath
headline: Exploring finance, entrepreneurship and venture capital.
intro: I’m Satvik Vishwanath, a first-year BBA student at T. A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI), Bengaluru, part of MAHE. I’m interested in how businesses grow, how financial decisions shape their future, and how new ventures turn ideas into lasting value.
about: I am a first-year Bachelor of Business Administration student at T. A. Pai Management Institute (TAPMI), Bengaluru, part of Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE). My interests lie in finance, entrepreneurship, and venture capital. I am at the beginning of my academic and professional journey, and I am using coursework and projects to build a stronger understanding of business fundamentals, financial thinking, and the challenges of building and scaling ventures. This portfolio is a record of what I learn, the questions I explore, and the work I complete along the way.
